items.issue: The proposed USD 50 million payment, CNY 30 million transfer or betrothal-gift characterization, chronology and court-recovery status are relayed through edited posts and narration, not verified primary records.
items.disposition: Do not present any named-person allegation, amount or legal status as fact; retain only as attributed context.

items.issue: Mikey's repayment and litigation comments are not tied to a jurisdiction, contract, filing or judgment and simplify contested property and relationship law.
items.disposition: Do not derive legal advice or a definitive entitlement to repayment from this video.

items.issue: The provider-versus-lover model and claims about women's 'bottom code' are categorical gender generalizations without supporting evidence.
items.disposition: Keep do_not_generalize and unavailable for first-person or action advice.

items.issue: The claim that changing for one woman necessarily makes her lose attraction assigns a universal cause and an unobservable subconscious motive.
items.disposition: Keep as Mikey's theory only; do not state it as a prediction about an individual woman.

items.issue: Descriptions of named people's private attitudes, pet names, sexual preferences and comparative relationship dynamics are inferred from gossip, edited screenshots and Mikey's interpretation.
items.disposition: Do not use as biographical fact; if cited in research notes, explicitly attribute to Mikey's interpretation.

items.issue: Screenshots and article cards are cropped, too small in several frames and not complete source documents.
items.disposition: Do not quote unreadable text, reconstruct omissions or treat the montage as a complete evidentiary record.

items.issue: The final 496.1-510.0 second material follows Mikey's sign-off, changes subject and lacks reliable speaker and relevance attribution.
items.disposition: Exclude the tail from substantive claims.

items.issue: Automatic ASR repeatedly misrecognizes public-figure names and key terms, including 孙宇晨, 景甜, 慕强, 彩礼 and 服从性测试.
items.disposition: Use normalized names only where confirmed by the title or readable cards; do not quote uncertain ASR wording without audio review.
